newsitem.title: ITALY: Italgas gas sales down in Jan/Feb 1997.
newsitem.headline: Italgas gas sales down in Jan/Feb 1997.

text.p: Italgas, Italy's largest retail gas distributor and part of state energy group ENI, said gas sales were 5.5 percent down in January and February this year due to milder than usual weather conditions.

Italgas said in a statement after its AGM that given normal weather for the period sales would have risen by 4.7 percent. For the whole of 1997, however, gas sales should be in line with 1996 levels. It did not give a comparative figure.
The group posted 1996 net profit of 64 billion lire, down 33 percent on 1995, paying an unchanged dividend of 130 lire.
It said it planned total investments this year of around 685 billion lire.
The number of customers by end-1997 should increase by some 175,000, of which around 49,000 coming from Italgas's Hungarian unit Tigaz Rt in which it took a majority stake in 1995.
